exams.name: EPA Section 609 Motor Vehicle Air Conditioning Technician Certification
exams.body: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency approved programmes
exams.blurb: Federally required credential for technicians who service motor vehicle air conditioning systems and handle automotive refrigerants.

exams.name: EPA Section 608 Type I Certification
exams.body: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency approved programmes
exams.blurb: Federal credential for servicing small appliances containing regulated refrigerants such as household refrigerators.

exams.name: EPA Section 608 Type II Certification
exams.body: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency approved programmes
exams.blurb: Federal credential for servicing high-pressure HVAC equipment and recovering refrigerant from residential systems.

exams.name: EPA Section 608 Type III Certification
exams.body: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency approved programmes
exams.blurb: Federal credential for servicing low-pressure appliances such as centrifugal chillers using regulated refrigerants.

exams.name: EPA Section 608 Universal Certification
exams.body: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency approved programmes
exams.blurb: Federal credential combining Type I, II and III approvals to service any appliance containing regulated refrigerants.

exams.name: I-CAR Platinum Individual Recognition
exams.body: Inter-Industry Conference on Auto Collision Repair (I-CAR)
exams.blurb: Recognition awarded to collision repair professionals who complete ProLevel 3 in a role and maintain annual continuing education.

exams.name: I-CAR ProLevel 1 Role-Based Training
exams.body: Inter-Industry Conference on Auto Collision Repair (I-CAR)
exams.blurb: First stage of I-CAR role-based collision repair training, covering foundational knowledge for estimators, technicians and refinishers.

exams.name: I-CAR ProLevel 2 Role-Based Training
exams.body: Inter-Industry Conference on Auto Collision Repair (I-CAR)
exams.blurb: Second stage of I-CAR role-based collision repair training, adding intermediate repair procedures and vehicle technology knowledge.

exams.name: I-CAR ProLevel 3 Role-Based Training
exams.body: Inter-Industry Conference on Auto Collision Repair (I-CAR)
exams.blurb: Final stage of I-CAR role-based training, completing the knowledge path required for Platinum recognition in a collision repair role.

exams.name: HVAC Excellence Carbon Monoxide Safety Certification
exams.blurb: Specialty credential covering combustion analysis, CO detection and prevention of carbon monoxide hazards.

exams.name: HVAC Excellence Employment Ready Certification
exams.blurb: Entry credential verifying foundational HVACR knowledge for students entering the workforce.

exams.name: HVAC Excellence Master Specialist Certification
exams.blurb: Advanced credential in a specific HVACR specialty for technicians with substantial field experience.

exams.name: HVAC Excellence Professional Technician Certification
exams.blurb: Certification covering core HVACR competencies for working technicians seeking professional recognition.

exams.name: Automotive Service Technician State Licensing Examination
exams.body: State motor vehicle repair licensing agencies
exams.blurb: Umbrella for the small number of states that license motor vehicle repair technicians by specialty area rather than relying on ASE alone.

exams.name: Association of Energy Engineers Certified Energy Manager (CEM)
exams.blurb: Premier credential for energy professionals managing energy use, audits and efficiency projects in facilities.

exams.name: Building Performance Institute Building Analyst (BPI BA)
exams.blurb: Certifies whole-house energy assessment, blower-door testing and improvement recommendations for existing homes.

exams.name: RESNET HERS Rater
exams.blurb: Certifies energy rating and modelling of homes, producing the HERS index used in mortgages and energy programmes.
